notes: Largest US reloading retailer; carries bullets, powders, primers, brass and loaded ammo. Link template is the site search form - no product-feed deep link captured yet. Affiliate network left NULL on purpose: the project README names AvantLink but also warns several programs have since migrated, so it is unconfirmed and must not be guessed.

Strong on reloading components and specialty bullets. Ships to the UK and EU, which matters for reach. Template is a site search; per-SKU URLs use a different path we have not captured. Affiliate network unconfirmed - see midwayusa note.

Known for in-stock reloading components and transparent inventory counts. One of the easiest retailers to verify stock against, which makes it a good first target for the scraper lane. Affiliate network unconfirmed - see midwayusa note.
General firearms retailer. Ammo and brass heavy, thinner on match bullets and powders than the specialist reloading houses. Carries a wide accessories range that a component finder can also surface.
Match-oriented and carries a good spread of premium bullets. Not a full reloading-supply house - powder availability in particular is limited.
One of the two houses that genuinely covers the whole reloading supply range: powders, primers, bullets, brass, scales and presses. A strong default for powder and primer queries.
Optics and accessories rather than reloading components. Included because the finder should still be able to surface a scope or mount for a given cartridge, but it is a weak source for components.
Firearms and accessories. Limited reloading component range; included for completeness of the directory rather than as a primary component source.

Price-comparison aggregator listing 273 retailers. Not a stockist itself - it links out rather than holding inventory, so it is a discovery source rather than a source of price. Worth recording because it is the yardstick our coverage is measured against.

National sporting-goods chain with a substantial ammunition and reloading department. Added for reach rather than component depth: it is one of the few retailers a non-specialist user will already have a relationship with.

National outdoor chain, strong hunting-ammunition and rifle presence, thinner on match components. Overlaps Bass Pro; recorded because coverage of a popular retailer is expected, not because it is a specialist.
Value-oriented ammunition retailer. Relevant because the reload-vs-buy verdict is a COST comparison, and the cheap end of the store-bought price range is what makes reloading look worthwhile.
Reloading specialist carrying an unusually wide brass range including obsolete and hard-to-find cases. Directly relevant to the brass half of reloading even though we sell none of it ourselves.
European reloading specialist shipping to UK and EU. Matters because most of our sources are US-only and our CIP/NATO cartridge naming has no EU-priced counterpart without a retailer like this.
Mid-market ammunition retailer, useful as a neutral middle point between the discount and premium ends when a price-per-round comparison is drawn.
Ammo-focused retailer. Recorded as a candidate; its terms have not been read, so scraping_status remains unknown and no automated lookup may target it.
